summary: Murder conviction appeal; reversal of High Court's conviction based on reappreciation of evidence; standard: benefit of doubt in criminal cases; prosecution failed to prove motive, premeditation, or identification beyond reasonable doubt; eyewitness testimony inconsistent on key details (timing, weapon, sequence); forensic evidence inconclusive; acquittal by Trial Court restored; High Court's interference improper in second appeal.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code s.302 read with s.34
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment setting aside acquittal set aside; Trial Court acquittal restored.
